notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content: A few small changes to room descriptions to make it easier to move around. Saves from previous versions may no longer work. Therefore, I will do my best to keep updates to a minimum. I apologize for any inconveniences caused by this update.

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
A small update to a single room to make the description clearer. This update might make older saves return an error. I am very sorry for any inconvenience this might cause. I will keep updates to a minimum to avoid any such inconveniences in the future.

I hope you are all enjoying the game! Thank you so much for your support!
